name: Razorfield Ripper
oracle_text:
Whenever this creature or equipped creature attacks, you get {E} (an energy counter), then it gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the amount of {E} you have.
Reconfigure—Pay {2} or {E}{E}{E}. (Pay {2} or {E}{E}{E}: Attach to target creature you control; or unattach from a creature. Reconfigure only as a sorcery. While attached, this isn't a creature.)
blocked_sentences: Whenever this creature or equipped creature attacks, you get {E} (an energy counter), then it gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is the amount of {E} you have.

needs.what: a value expression reading how many energy counters a player has (PlayerState.energy), e.g. {"energy_of": "you"}, usable as a pump's power/toughness so "it gets +X/+X where X is the amount of {E} you have" can be said
needs.why_existing_wont_do: value_keys has counters_on, which reads counters on objects only (a player is not an object), and max_poison_of / max_life_of, which read poison and life but not energy; add_energy and the pay_energy cost exist, and may.any_amount binds energy PAID, but nothing reads the energy a player currently holds
